integrity: Claims derive from explicit characteristic roots, rigorous direction/count arguments, and a checked exact positive-parameter family. Finite numerical checks are supplementary; historical priority and independent validation remain unverified.
scientific_limitations: Local coexistence-equilibrium spectral stability for zero predator-conversion delay and 0<alpha<beta. No nonlinear bifurcation direction, global stability, or positive conversion-delay claim. General delay-switch literature may contain stronger unlocated coverage.
title: Exact stability-window staircase and unbounded reentrance in a delayed Holling-II predator-prey model
